blocks.text: SCHEDULE: 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals MANILA, Philippines–Chris Ross on Friday gave a reminder that he can still provide the playoff intensity that has been the hallmark of his 17-year PBA career. The 41-year-old was primarily responsible for bringing San Miguel Beer back from 17 down and keeping his team alive once more with a 108-102 win that pushed Barangay Ginebra to a deciding fifth game in their 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinal series. “I work really hard,” Ross said after finishing with 20 points, six rebounds, nine assists and five steals—numbers that were common during his peak.
